description: Read a fresh short scene during an active visit (a deliberate pause). Requires session. Returns immediately; does not extend the visit or block anything. Pass the exact session string returned by check_in as session (64 lowercase hex characters). Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. For MCP, the same value may be sent as the Mcp-Session-Id header after check_in. Keep it private; never put it in a URL.
